notes: Sheet is drawn rotated (north arrow points to the right). Lock (60', centre x~597, block lines 490/710) runs page-vertical; at (605,1334) it meets a Y: the 30 ft 'LOCK' leg to the NE and an unlabelled ~53 ft leg to the NW carrying the 6" and 40" pipes, which is E 8th coming from sheet 141; the pipes then run down Lock and turn east into the page-horizontal 'E. 8TH' (block lines 1496/1638) at y 1567, so Lock has two E 8th junctions (first = NW leg, second = page-horizontal leg). Y point = centroid of the three centreline crossings. E 8th's NE diagonal (block faces ~33 ft apart) ends in the open plaza at Gilbert Av's south line (2808,803), where E Court's south road (x~2983-3150, 50') also arrives; both continue into Gilbert Av (100', block lines 493/836, centre ~665). E Court's NW leg (66', from the top) meets Gilbert's west end at (2287,665); west of that the 'RE-INFORCED CONCRETE VIADUCT' continues Gilbert toward the upper left (sheet 141). E 6th diagonal ~35-50 ft, crosses E Court's south road at y~1531 and continues east (50' gap in the outline east of E Court). Baum (35' at 6th) leaves the 6th/Lock-side junction SSE; it widens to ~90' near Monastery and 5th. Monastery (40') runs from Baum NE, bends ESE and continues to the right edge; Oregon (40') branches south at (3035,2405). Monastery/Baum is where the Monastery centreline meets the estimated Baum centreline (Baum is very wide there). Baum/E 5th: 5th appears only as a sheet-136 outline west of Baum (centre y~3925); point at Baum's mid-width, approximate. 'STREET (NOT OPEN)' between Monastery and Oregon is not recorded. The 10 ft alley between Baum and Oregon (printed 10' at both ends) is approximate and ends at the Mt Adams & Eden Park Inclined Plane. Oregon's bend/curve south of Monastery not measured. Points in the Monastery/Oregon/Baum area are approximate (+/-25 px).
